## Void Deck 1.4.0

**The game details page now speaks the same language as the rest of Void Deck.** Open any game and the page has
been reworked around four ideas, all drawn on the same dots.

**The hero art prints as a dot screen.** The header image is desaturated and covered by the interface's own 8 px
lattice, so the artwork reads as halftone rather than a photo pasted onto the page. This also brings the details
page in line with the Library, where covers were already grayscale.

**Stats read as a spec sheet.** Playtime, achievements and last played are now label-and-value rows: a small
uppercase label, a dotted leader running to the right, and the value in dot-matrix numerals on a shared right edge.

**Progress is a dot meter.** Install, update and download progress becomes a dotted track with the fill cut into
4 px bars, matching the battery and volume meters instead of a solid bar.

**Frames instead of cards.** Sections are hairline outlines with a three-dot corner marker, tabs are uppercase
mono with a dotted underline on the active one, and keyboard focus on the tab row is a dotted outline.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from ZIP*, then select `VoidDeck-v1.4.0.zip` from this
release. Or press **Update now** in the Void Deck panel.
